name: v1.1-11200
body:
## PlayerStates

adds a couple macro helpers to Vanilla WoW.
- PlayerState.Channeling (true when the player is channeling a spell)
- PlayerState.Spelltargeting (true when the player has a spell loaded on the cursor)

#### Macro Usage Examples

Spammable Tame beast (will not try to recast Tame Beast and interrupt it when already channeling)  

``` lua
/tar Broken Tooth
/script if (UnitName("target"))=="Broken Tooth" and not PlayerState.Channeling then CastSpellByName("Tame Beast") end
```

Spammable Blizzard (will not try to cast Blizzard when the spell is already loaded on cursor)  

``` lua
/script if not PlayerState.Spelltargeting then CastSpellByName("Blizzard") end
```
